walk.action_rule: zero-logit dithered-book proposal, seed-fixed, legality-masked per state (834 precedent) — checkpoint-independent; single env, fixed start at the first obs-valid row (835 pattern)

momentum.primary: book: current holdings revalued at rows t-1 vs t-1-m (compute_portfolio_value at two price rows; positions/cash/entries frozen — holdings-weighted trailing asset momentum, NOT the trailing walk PV)
momentum.secondary: market: equal-weight cross-asset mean trailing return, rows t-1 vs t-1-m (padded columns double-count — diagnostic only)
momentum.walk_pv: walk_pv: pv_pre[t]/pv_pre[t-m]-1 on the walk PV series — the true trailing-PV time-mirror of the realized leg (rows <= t, the realized-leg mark convention, never beyond t; requires t >= m, earlier states excluded from this leg only; secondary/diagnostic — the pre-registered PRIMARY stays the book baseline)
momentum.why_m21: ~1 month at the canonical daily bars — the standard time-series-momentum lookback; < warm=window_size so it is always computable without leaving the panel

horizons.realized: pv_pre[t+k]/pv_pre[t] - 1 along the SAME deterministic walk — the k-decision continuation under the same pre-registered rule, computed by the true env (jit_batch_step_vector); CONDITIONAL on the walk rule, not the trained policy
horizons.p_caveat: p-values assume independent samples; k>1 forward windows overlap by k-1 steps (effective n ~ n/k), making p anti-conservative — treat p as descriptive only; the interpretation rule uses rho comparisons exclusively

leak_check.momentum_walk_pv_rows: [t-21, t] — rows <= t, the realized-leg mark convention (never beyond t)
leak_check.realized_rows: [t, t+k] — FUTURE relative to the state (its purpose)

interpretation.rule_verbatim: value beats momentum's correlation on ≥3/5 windows = the value net carries signal beyond the obvious; below-momentum everywhere = the value net is the bottleneck (feeds the phase-2 postmortem either way — this probe is DIAGNOSTIC, it gates nothing by itself)
interpretation.reading: FIXTURE-SMOKE (untrained fresh-init model) — plumbing proof only; interpretation NOT applied. Real reading = scheduled run on the phase-1 cost0 snapshots.
